title: 2015-2017 Toyota Aqua 1.5 Hybrid S
nvh_summary: Quiet enough in town but starts to sound busy at open-road speeds.
ride_handling_summary: Easy urban driving with light steering and stable low-speed manners.
comfort_summary: Best for short commuting rather than long-distance comfort.
space_summary: Compact rear seat and boot compared with larger hatchbacks.
reliability_summary: Strong reliability reputation when hybrid battery health and service history are clean.
suitability_summary: Excellent for city commuting, easy parking, and low running-cost priorities.

title: 2016-2018 Toyota Prius 1.8 Hybrid S
nvh_summary: Calmer than an Aqua on the highway but still economy-car focused.
ride_handling_summary: Predictable and efficient rather than sporty.
comfort_summary: Good commuter comfort with a practical cabin for daily use.
space_summary: Useful cargo room and better rear-seat practicality than most small hybrids.
reliability_summary: Generally proven hybrid package if commercial-use wear and service history are checked carefully.
suitability_summary: Strong all-round profile for commuting, rideshare-style use, and fuel economy.

title: 2018-2020 Toyota RAV4 2.0 Petrol GX
nvh_summary: Reasonably refined for the class, with some tyre noise on rough surfaces.
ride_handling_summary: Secure and easy to place, focused on comfort over agility.
comfort_summary: Good seating position and everyday family usability.
space_summary: Useful rear seat and boot space without being oversized.
reliability_summary: Solid mainstream SUV choice if service history and wear items line up.
suitability_summary: Best for family space, visibility, and SUV practicality rather than lowest running cost.

title: 2014-2016 Honda Fit 1.5 Petrol L
nvh_summary: Average small-car isolation with more engine sound under acceleration than a larger hatch.
ride_handling_summary: Light and easy to drive, tuned for city practicality.
comfort_summary: Front cabin feels airy, rear seat comfort is decent for the size.
space_summary: Very flexible cabin layout for a compact footprint.
reliability_summary: Usually dependable if transmission feel, service history, and general condition are confirmed.
suitability_summary: Excellent city and errands profile for buyers who want space efficiency without SUV cost.

title: 2014-2017 Honda Fit 1.5 Hybrid F
nvh_summary: Quiet at city pace, with drivetrain transitions that feel busier than Toyota hybrids.
ride_handling_summary: Nimble and efficient with a slightly more technical drivetrain feel.
comfort_summary: Good commuter comfort, though drivetrain smoothness matters on used examples.
space_summary: Practical hatchback packaging with strong interior flexibility.
reliability_summary: Can be economical and practical, but gearbox behaviour and maintenance history deserve closer scrutiny than on simpler petrol versions.
suitability_summary: Strong low-fuel-use profile if the buyer is comfortable checking hybrid and gearbox condition carefully.

title: 2016-2018 Honda Civic 1.8 Petrol S
nvh_summary: More settled and quieter than most small hatchbacks at highway speed.
ride_handling_summary: Balanced and confidence-inspiring for commuting and first-car use.
comfort_summary: Comfortable front seats and mature highway manners.
space_summary: Useful rear seat and boot for a compact sedan.
reliability_summary: Generally low-drama if service records are strong and tyres/brakes are up to date.
suitability_summary: Strong all-rounder for buyers who want a safer-feeling compact car with better long-drive comfort.

title: 2016-2018 Honda HR-V 1.5 Petrol S
nvh_summary: Acceptably quiet in town, with moderate road noise on coarse surfaces.
ride_handling_summary: Easy to drive and park for an SUV-shaped vehicle.
comfort_summary: Higher seating position without the bulk of a larger SUV.
space_summary: Useful for small-family errands but not as roomy as a mid-size SUV.
reliability_summary: Reasonably dependable if service history and suspension/brake wear are confirmed.
suitability_summary: Good for buyers who want easy ingress and compact-SUV visibility without moving to a larger vehicle.

title: 2015-2018 Mazda2 1.5 Petrol GSX
nvh_summary: Acceptable for a small hatch, but road noise is more noticeable than in larger cars.
ride_handling_summary: Direct steering and tidy body control for the segment.
comfort_summary: Better front-seat feel than many budget hatches, but still compact overall.
space_summary: Rear seat and cargo area are fine for solo use, tighter for family duties.
reliability_summary: Simple and usually predictable if the buyer avoids neglected bargain examples.
suitability_summary: Good low-budget city profile for solo driving, easy parking, and simple ownership.

title: 2016-2018 Mazda3 2.0 Petrol GLX
nvh_summary: Better highway composure than most entry hatchbacks, though coarse-chip noise remains present.
ride_handling_summary: Confident steering and composed chassis with a more mature feel than economy-focused hatches.
comfort_summary: Feels more refined than most small commuter cars.
space_summary: Balanced hatchback practicality without SUV bulk.
reliability_summary: Well-regarded overall, but high-mileage examples still need suspension, brake, and service-history checks.
common_issues: oil leak checks on high-mileage cars
suitability_summary: Strong for buyers who want a more refined compact with good daily usability and decent efficiency.

title: 2017-2018 Mazda3 2.5 Petrol Limited
nvh_summary: More refined than budget hatches, with better highway ease and cabin calm.
ride_handling_summary: Sharper and more engaging than mainstream commuter-focused alternatives.
comfort_summary: Premium-leaning compact feel with strong everyday comfort.
space_summary: Similar practicality to the 2.0L version, with more premium trim content.
reliability_summary: Generally solid, but tyres, brakes, and maintenance quality matter more because buyers often pay a premium for this spec.
suitability_summary: Best for buyers who value refinement, stronger performance, and a more premium compact-car experience.

title: 2017-2019 Mazda CX-5 2.0 Petrol GLX
nvh_summary: Reasonably refined for a family SUV, with some tyre noise as speed rises.
ride_handling_summary: Comfort-focused but still tidy by SUV standards.
comfort_summary: Comfortable seats and good general family usability.
space_summary: Solid rear-seat and boot space for daily family use.
reliability_summary: Usually dependable if suspension, brakes, and service intervals have been kept up.
suitability_summary: Strong practical SUV profile for families who want space and comfort without going too large.

title: 2017-2019 Mazda CX-5 2.5 Petrol Limited
nvh_summary: Refined cabin for the class with a calmer premium feel than many mainstream SUVs.
ride_handling_summary: Stable, confident, and a little more composed than cheaper SUV variants.
comfort_summary: Comfort-oriented family SUV with a clear premium tilt.
space_summary: Same practical footprint as the GLX with more comfort and trim appeal.
reliability_summary: Usually sound, but extra purchase cost makes tyre, brake, and maintenance history more important to justify.
suitability_summary: Best for buyers who want family SUV practicality with more comfort and a stronger premium feel.
